metadata.note: Virginia extensions of Amtrak's Northeast Regional, which branch south and west from Washington Union Station. These are absent from amtrak.geojson, whose Northeast Regional feature covers only the Boston-Washington Northeast Corridor shape. Four branches are modelled: Newport News (continuous since 1971), Norfolk (2012), Lynchburg (2009-2017) and Roanoke (2017-). Lynchburg and Roanoke are the same train - the Lynchburg feature ends in 2017 when the run was extended west to Roanoke, so the two do not overlap in time. The Newport News and Norfolk branches share the RF&P alignment out of Washington with the Silver Meteor, Palmetto and Carolinian and will draw on top of them there. Geometry is real OpenStreetMap trace; headways are approximations from published service history, NOT the GTFS-derived counts used in amtrak.geojson.
metadata.line_label_audit: 2026-08-24: line labels normalised repo-wide to "<operating company>: <line name>" -- the company's common display name (legal suffixes dropped), then the line as a passenger would have known it, or its two terminals where the line carried no advertised name. Long intermediate station lists were reduced to endpoints. For features spanning several operators the company shown is the one that ran the line for most of its drawn years. See CLAUDE.md Rule 6.
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Northeast_Regional -- Wikipedia, "Northeast Regional"; lead paragraph confirms this article covers the railroad drawn in this layer. Added 2026-08-24 as a layer-level reference.
